state.architecture:
Title: Blog App Test Fix Architecture
Summary: System design to execute, analyze, and resolve failing tests within the Code_Playback blog application test suite through target fixes and environment isolation.
Components:
- [MODIFY] Blog Application Test Suite & Source: Existing test suite and application code in the Code_Playback directory requiring execution, defect analysis, and target fixes. (Responsibilities: Execute automated unit and integration tests, Isolate external dependencies using mocks, Ensure zero test failures and clean exit code)
Data Flow: Test Runner loads environment configuration and test suite from Code_Playback directory. -> Test Suite executes assertions against Blog Application components and services. -> Test Runner captures pass/fail output and returns system exit code.
Dependencies: Project runtime environment (Node.js/Python based on repository setup), Project test framework (e.g., Jest, Pytest, Vitest), Package dependencies from Code_Playback project configuration
Risks: Uninstalled dependencies or missing environment variables preventing test execution; Flaky or unmocked network/database calls causing non-deterministic failures; Potential regressions introduced while fixing failing tests
Verification Plan: Install and verify project dependencies within Code_Playback directory.; Execute complete test runner command and inspect output log.; Confirm test suite finishes with 0 failures and exit code 0 without regressing existing tests.

Ensure test scripts, jest, ts-jest, and @types/jest are included in package.json devDependencies and script definitions.
